title: Elux Legend Hawaii Sunrise Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Hawaii Sunrise Nic Salt combines a vibrant blend of tropical fruit flavours, pairing light, juicy Watermelon with sweet, fragrant Peach and rich, tangy Pineapple. This remarkable e-liquid captures tropical sunshine in a 10ml bottle, delivering a well-rounded flavour profile that’s bright, refreshing, and deliciously exotic. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold, intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. Crafted with a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, making them perfect for vapers who crave satisfying and flavoursome tropical blends. Mixed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Hawaii Sunrise Nic Salt is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is perfect for adult smokers and vapers seeking a taste of the tropics.
